body: The pre-board examinations for Class X will commence on 18 May 2026 and conclude on 30 May 2026. The detailed date sheet has been shared via the parent app.
Examinations will run from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM. Students must report by 8:30 AM in full school uniform with their admit cards.
We request your active cooperation in ensuring regular study hours and adequate rest in the lead-up to the examinations.
